assertions.description: MediaSource.isTypeSupported is a function — the capability entry point IAMF-over-MSE is detected through (the feature adds no new API by design).
audio/mp4 with codecs iamf.001.001.Opus reports MSE support on a build with the IamfAudioDecoding feature and iamf-tools decoder (Chrome 152 developer trial).
A malformed IAMF codec string (2-digit profile violates the 3-digit grammar of IAMF §6.3) must NOT report support — the parser rejects it even on IAMF-enabled builds.
A substream codec outside the accepted set (Opus, mp4a.40.2, flac, ipcm) must NOT report support.
mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo for the media-source IAMF Opus type resolves with a boolean supported field that agrees with isTypeSupported (the two capability surfaces must not contradict).
assertions.test: (async()=>{ if (!navigator.mediaCapabilities?.decodingInfo) return false; const type = 'audio/mp4; codecs="iamf.001.001.Opus"'; const info = await navigator.mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo({ type: 'media-source', audio: { contentType: type } }); return typeof info.supported === 'boolean' && info.supported === MediaSource.isTypeSupported(type); })()

assertions.description: Initial milestone is MSE-only: on a build where MSE reports IAMF support, progressive src= playback via canPlayType may still report empty — canPlayType must never report MORE support than MSE for IAMF (no false 'probably' without a decoder).
assertions.test: (()=>{ const type = 'audio/mp4; codecs="iamf.001.001.Opus"'; const cpt = document.createElement('audio').canPlayType(type); const mse = MediaSource.isTypeSupported(type); return !(cpt !== '' && !mse); })()

assertions.description: addSourceBuffer with the IAMF type either succeeds (decoder present) or throws a real NotSupportedError — it must never silently create a buffer it cannot decode nor throw a different error for the unsupported case.
assertions.test: (async()=>{ const type = 'audio/mp4; codecs="iamf.001.001.Opus"'; const ms = new MediaSource(); const a = document.createElement('audio'); const url = URL.createObjectURL(ms); a.src = url; await new Promise((res, rej) => { const t = setTimeout(() => rej(new Error('sourceopen timeout')), 4000); ms.addEventListener('sourceopen', () => { clearTimeout(t); res(); }, { once: true }); }); let ok; try { ms.addSourceBuffer(type); ok = MediaSource.isTypeSupported(type) === true; } catch (e) { ok = e.name === 'NotSupportedError' && MediaSource.isTypeSupported(type) === false; } URL.revokeObjectURL(url); return ok; })()
